hook: Both 150 kW. Both tow 3.5 tonnes. $400 apart. The new Triton takes on the new 48V HiLux.

stories.a: Carries more, costs less and comes with a 10-year warranty.
stories.b: 30 Nm more, a 48V mild-hybrid and the resale of Australia's most famous badge.
stories.take: Toyota buyers buy the badge. Mitsubishi buyers buy the warranty.
